label: New document
description: Create a blank document in the current folder.

label: Duplicate document
description: Make a copy of the document that is currently open.

label: Export as PDF
description: Write the current document out as a PDF file on disk.

label: Restore previous version
description: Roll the document back to an earlier saved version from history.

label: Move to folder
description: Relocate the current document into a different folder.

label: Move to trash
description: Delete the current document, recoverable from trash.

label: Invite collaborators
description: Give a named person edit or comment access to this document.

label: Copy share link
description: Copy a URL that lets others open this document.

label: Remove access
description: Take away a person's existing access to this document.

label: Publish to web
description: Make the document readable by anyone with no sign-in.

label: Find and replace
description: Search text in the document and substitute another string.

label: Undo last change
description: Reverse the most recent edit.

label: Toggle suggesting mode
description: Switch edits to tracked suggestions instead of direct changes.

label: Show document statistics
description: Open the panel with word and character statistics.

label: Apply heading style
description: Format the selected paragraph as a heading.

label: Clear formatting
description: Strip bold, italics, colour and font overrides from the selection.

label: Insert table
description: Place a grid of rows and columns at the cursor.

label: Insert page break
description: Force the following content onto a new page.

label: Switch to dark theme
description: Change the editor appearance to the dark colour scheme.

label: Enter focus mode
description: Hide toolbars and side panels while writing.

label: Show document outline
description: Open the navigation sidebar listing headings.

label: Resolve all comments
description: Mark every open comment thread as resolved.

label: Add comment
description: Attach a comment to the current selection.

label: Sign out
description: End the current session and return to the login screen.

label: Keyboard shortcuts
description: Show the list of keyboard shortcuts for this app.

label: Make available offline
description: Cache this document so it opens without a network connection.
